seed: At Next defaults, no flag set: the 6 minute reference edit, whose V1 track is busy enough that its plain clips and the cuts between them are painted as one layer (the-timeline-of-an-hour-long-edit-scrolls-zooms). A person rests the pointer on a clip, zooms the timeline out with the pointer held still so a cut slides under it, and clicks without moving: the cut is what gets picked, not the clip under it. The edit opens at Fit with the playhead at 0:00, and zooming out from there keeps 0:00 at the left and doubles the time under any point, so the pointer resting at 1:45.25 (the middle of the clip from 1:39.8 to 1:51.9) is over the plain cut at 3:30.5 afterwards.

steps.comment: The pointer comes to rest on V1 at 1:45.25, in the middle of a clip and well clear of the cuts at either end.
The timeline zooms out with the pointer held still: 0:00 stays at the left and everything halves in width, so the plain cut at 3:30.5 is under the pointer.
A real click where the pointer rests, with no move first.
The cut is picked, so no clip is.

steps.note: THE CLICK: the cut at 3:30.5 is picked and no clip is
